channel.description: Latest articles from The American Mind (americanmind.org)

item.title: Playing the Wrong Game
item.description: Leftists are targeting billionaires in California and elsewhere because they want to seize the power of that wealth for themselves.

item.title: The Second Sex and the Radicalism of Modern Feminism
item.description: Our increasingly sexless/genderless world is palpably and radically out of touch with many undeniable facts of reality.

item.title: The LGBTQ Tidal Wave Was Never About a Social Contagion
item.description: Radicals aim to change the distribution of privilege from historically favored groups to historically disfavored ones.

item.title: The Case Against Federal Reserve Independence
item.description: Economic stability is obviously desirable, but we cannot purchase it at the cost of the principle of self-government.

item.title: The Age of America
item.description: Americans need to recover a sense of their country as an era-defining project, forward-looking but steeped in traditions of faith and law.

item.title: From Alaska to Antarctica: The Next Great American Expansion
item.description: A declaration of sovereignty on Independence Day would wrap a bold geopolitical move in the most durable possible American framing.

item.title: D.C. Media Blob Beclowned by SAVE Act Debate
item.description: They might salvage some of their profession’s evaporating credibility if they spent more time challenging the establishment's spin.

item.title: How the Homeland Became a Combat Zone
item.description: Brandon Shah should still be alive, a husband to his wife, a father to his child, and a mentor to his students.

item.title: Retrieving America’s Natural Aristocracy
item.description: In the 250th year of America’s birth, let us resolve to elevate only natural aristocrats into public offices.

item.title: Living Under the Feminist Gaze
item.description: Sam Adler-Bell's essay seeks to prevent any discussion of controversial truths about sex differences in order to protect the girlboss regime.

item.title: Seizing the Working Class Opportunity in AI Data Centers
item.description: Giving workers an ownership stake in pivotal AI development would overcome the perception of an economic system that benefits only the elite.

item.title: American Renewal and the Continuity of the West
item.description: America's spiritual, cultural, and political recovery will demand strength of soul and truly arduous efforts.

item.title: The American Mind Podcast: The Roundtable Episode 311 Congress Take the Wheel
item.description: Amid an ongoing congressional battle over Department of Homeland Security funding, the House Democrats eked out a bill in the early hours last Friday—excluding ICE and Border Patrol. After a century of Congressional abdication, submission to bureaucracy has become second nature. And in making war, most recently with Iran, the atrophy of the government's first branch calls into question the separation of powers. Plus: Oral arguments for Trump v. Barbara, on birthright citizenship, begin this week

item.title: Deserving Success: America at 250
item.description: There are no guarantees in the daunting task of reviving America, yet that does not absolve us of our moral duty.

item.title: How the Beltway Media Machine Works
item.description: The interests of politicians and journalists used to look like a Venn diagram: divergent with small overlap. Now that picture is a circle.
